description: Hardware-defined NVIDIA channel structures (instance block / RAMIN, RAMFC, USERD, runlist entries) per generation. Byte offsets from the start of the structure. Bit-field specs are [byte_offset, hi_bit, lo_bit]. Source table: docs/research/NVIDIA_HW_FACTS.md section 2.10 (instance block offsets per generation), 2.11 (USERD), topic 3 (runlists).

provenance: NVIDIA nvgpu GK20A hw_ram_gk20a.h (Kepler) [NVIDIA-published] + nouveau gk104 channel code: RAMFC USERD 0x08/0x0C, SIGNATURE 0x10 (0xFACE), GP_GET 0x14, GP_BASE 0x48/0x4C (LIMIT2 20:16), HCE_CTRL 0xE4 (priv bit 5), CHID 0xE8 11:0; RAMIN page directory 0x200/0x204
Kepler runlists hold 8-byte entries with channel ids only (no instance pointer): they cannot be tied to instance blocks from memory alone
NVIDIA published maxwell/gm107 dev_ram.h and nvgpu GM20B/GP10B headers [NVIDIA-published]: RAMFC/RAMIN offsets identical to Kepler
Runlist: 8-byte entries; nouveau writes the instance block address >> 12 in word1 from GM107 on and the runqueue at bit 14 on Pascal [nouveau]
Pascal selects VER1 or VER2 page tables per instance block with NV_RAMIN_USE_VER2_PT_FORMAT (bit 10 of word 128)
NVIDIA open-gpu-doc manuals/volta/gv100/dev_ram.ref.txt (NV_RAMIN_*, NV_RAMFC_*, NV_RAMUSERD_*, NV_RAMRL_ENTRY_*) [NVIDIA-published]
CHID at RAMFC 0xE8 per nvgpu GV11B ram_fc_chid_w() and nouveau; HCE privilege bit 5 (NV_PPBDMA_HCE_CTRL_HCE_PRIV_MODE 5:5)
As Volta; CHID is in SET_CHANNEL_INFO (RAMFC 0xFC) bits 27:16 as written by NVIDIA RM (open-gpu-kernel-modules) [NVIDIA-published RM code]
NVIDIA open-gpu-doc manuals/ampere/ga100/dev_ram.ref.txt [NVIDIA-published]: RAMFC words 2/3 (USERD) are reserved from Ampere on - USERD is located only through the runlist entry (CHAN_USERD_PTR)
CHID in SET_CHANNEL_INFO (0xFC) bits 27:16 (RM); GA10B instance blocks carry 0xcafeca11 at RAMIN 0x20C (RM-written)
NVIDIA published hopper/gh100 dev_ram.h delta [NVIDIA-published]: LIMIT2 moved to RAMFC 0xA4 bits 4:0, GP_BASE_HI widened to 24:0 (57-bit VA)

NVIDIA published blackwell/gb100 dev_ram.h [NVIDIA-published]: RAMFC rearranged - SIGNATURE 0x38, GP_BASE 0x90/0x94 (hi 24:0), GP_GET 0x98, GP_PUT 0xC0 (debug state), LIMIT2 0xB4 bits 28:24, HCE_CTRL 0x54
CHID: RAMFC 0x58 bits 27:16 on GB1xx/Rubin (RM); GB2xx writes no CHID to RAMFC. RAMIN 0x20C = 0xcafeca11 (RM-written marker)
USERD words other than GP_PUT are not republished for Blackwell and are assumed unchanged
